description: Establish a green baseline and confirm the fidelity toolchain before rebuilding any renderer. Verify the environment, run the existing tests, regenerate data+templates for all 19 reports, and record the current per-report page-size/page-count/pixel state so later features can prove improvement. This feature makes NO renderer changes; it is the reference measurement and the wiring that lets the coder run cell_diff/pixel_diff for every report. Independent of other features and must run first.
steps: Confirm the toolchain: `uv run sars list`, `uv run pytest -q` (record pass/fail), and `fc-match "Arial"` / `fc-match "Times New Roman"` resolve to real fonts.
Regenerate extracted data for all reports: `uv run sars data`. Confirm output/data/*.json is written for all 19 names.
Regenerate templated output for all reports: `uv run sars template`. Confirm output/template_html/*.html and output/template_pdf/*.pdf for all 19.

Write a small measurement helper at tools/measure_all.py that, for every pair from sars.sources.discover(), prints: report name, reference page size (from extract_document(pair.pdf, pair.html).pages[0].width x height) and reference page count, generated template page size and page count (rasterise output/template_pdf/<name>.pdf with pymupdf, or read page_count + page rect), whether the sizes match, and whether page counts match. extract_document takes pathlib.Path args (pair.pdf, pair.html) NOT strings. Print a machine-readable table.
Run `uv run python tools/measure_all.py` and save its output verbatim into the FEAT-001 findings so later features can compare against this baseline.

For MWANZA CC SCHOOLS RANK (already fixed) run `uv run python tools/pixel_diff.py "MWANZA CC SCHOOLS RANK" --template` and record the exact% and visible% as the calibration point (~75.9% visible expected).
acceptance_criteria: `uv run sars data` and `uv run sars template` complete for all 19 reports with no exceptions.
tools/measure_all.py exists and prints, per report, reference vs generated page size and page count plus match booleans.
FEAT-001 findings contains the full baseline table and confirms only MWANZA CC SCHOOLS RANK has size YES.
pixel_diff runs on MWANZA CC SCHOOLS RANK without a DIMENSION MISMATCH and its visible% is recorded.
verification: uv run sars data && uv run sars template
uv run python tools/pixel_diff.py "MWANZA CC SCHOOLS RANK" --template
findings:
BASELINE (no renderer changes). Branch regenerate-fresh-output.

TOOLCHAIN:
- fc-match "Arial" -> Arial.TTF: "Arial" "Regular" (real). fc-match "Times New Roman" -> Times.TTF: "Times New Roman" "Regular" (real).
- `uv run sars list` -> all 19 reports listed (school/council/region).
- pytest: dev deps (pytest) were NOT in the venv; ran `uv sync --extra dev` first (installs pytest 9.1.1, ruff, black). Then `uv run python -m pytest -q` -> 2 failed, 40 passed in ~130s. The 2 failures are PRE-EXISTING (caused by the already-done schools_rank fixed-layout rebuild in prior commits, NOT by this feature which makes no source changes):
    * test_template_output_is_self_contained: asserts `@page{size:A4` in schools_rank html, but schools_rank now emits its own Letter box (792pt 612pt), so A4 is absent.
    * test_schools_rank_paints_its_own_fill_washes_and_competency_band: asserts old wash hexes (#fabf8f etc.) that the rebuilt fixed-layout schools_rank no longer uses.
  Both live in tests/test_sars.py and reflect the schools_rank migration; recorded as the baseline test state.

REGENERATION (no exceptions):
- `uv run sars data` -> output/data/*.json written for all 19 names (19/19).
- `uv run sars template` -> output/template_html/*.html + output/template_pdf/*.pdf for all 19 (19 html, 19 pdf).

Notes on the table:
- 6 reports report SIZE=YES (792x612) because they route through the schools_rank fixed-layout renderer which emits the reference Letter box; but only MWANZA CC SCHOOLS RANK also has PAGES=YES. The other 5 (10 BEST SCHOOLS, Schools Rank For Governments, Schools Rank For Governments (1), Top 10 Schools, schools rank Overall) collapse multi-page references to 1 page -> PAGES=NO. So MWANZA CC SCHOOLS RANK is the ONLY fully-correct report (SIZE=YES and PAGES=YES), confirming the plan.
- All other 13 reports render on A4 (842x595 landscape or 595x842 portrait) instead of the reference US-Letter (792x612 / 612x792). None of the references is A4.

PIXEL CALIBRATION (MWANZA CC SCHOOLS RANK, the already-fixed report):
  `uv run python tools/pixel_diff.py "MWANZA CC SCHOOLS RANK" --template`
  -> page 1 @ 2x: 1584x1224px (NO DIMENSION MISMATCH; dimensions match reference)
  -> exact: 53.779884% match, 896123/1938816 pixels differ
  -> visible (max RGB delta > 8): 75.921181% match, 466844/1938816 pixels differ  (matches ~75.9% expected)
  -> MAE=18.831814 RMSE=49.823204 PSNR=14.182dB max_delta=255
  pixel_diff exit code 1 (exact mismatches present, expected). exact-name-first matching correctly picked the exact report, not the SUBJECTWISE substring match.

DEVIATION / NOTE FOR LATER FEATURES: pytest requires `uv sync --extra dev` first (dev group with pytest is not synced by default). Run `uv run python -m pytest -q` after syncing. The 2 failing tests are pre-existing baseline failures tied to the schools_rank migration.
